Meet the Team

The Solutions Engineering team at Cisco plays a meaningful role in accelerating the adoption of Cisco enterprise technologies by building, validating, and improving software-driven solutions across Catalyst Center, Meraki, Cisco Cloud Control, Catalyst 9000 wireless, switching and routing platforms, Identity Services Engine (ISE), and related controller-based systems.

The team drives customer-facing execution across solution validation, automation, and adoption for Cisco’s campus and branch networking portfolio. This includes supporting high-touch customer engagements, validating real-world customer use cases, developing automation workflows, improving regression coverage, and contributing to AI Assistant intents used to triage customer issues and support successful adoption.

Through close partnership with engineering, product management, field teams, TAC, and customers, the team helps identify product and solution gaps early, contain field issues, improve software quality, and ensure customer deployments move forward with confidence.

Your Impact

Accelerate customer adoption by validating real-world use cases, proof-of-concepts, test scenarios, and defect fixes for high-touch enterprise deployments.
Improve product and solution quality by debugging issues across development, validation, and customer environments, and by converting field learnings into stronger regression coverage.
Increase execution efficiency and engineering productivity through Python and REST API-based automation for development and testing, automated test frameworks, CI/CD validation pipelines, and daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, and approved Cisco AI tools.
Improve development velocity through close partnership with engineering, product management, design, sales, TAC, and customer-facing teams.
This provides an excellent opportunity to work closely with customers and their live deployments while gaining high visibility through critical customer-facing initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field with 7+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience.
Hands-on experience with campus, branch, data center, or service provider networking, including routing, switching, wireless technologies, network design, requirements analysis, and customer deployment workflows.
Previous programming experience with Python, REST API-based automation, and AI-assisted engineering tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude for network validation, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment workflows.
Shown ability to create user documentation, deliver demos and presentations, and work across engineering, product, sales, and customer-facing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cisco Catalyst Center, Catalyst 9000 switching, Cisco wireless, Meraki, and ISE.
Interest or experience in using AI tools (e.g., AI Agents, MCP, LLMs) to automate development and operational workflows.
Experience validating customer scenarios involving upgrades, HA/failover, roaming, segmentation, certificates, and automation workflows.
Strong test mindset with experience in regression testing, scale testing, and production issue analysis.
Ability to translate customer needs into actionable software, automation, and validation requirements.
Experience with writing testplans.
Familiarity with building, integrating and testing APIs.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

The Solutions Engineering Team at Box includes solutions engineers, value engineering, platform solution engineering, enterprise architects, and demo engineering. As a Solutions Engineer, you are empowered to sell to business and IT leaders in every space and vertical, and take ownership in crafting customer-centric solutions. You will work alongside the account team to define and expand revenue opportunities, and ensure the solution is ready for cross company deployments. You also act as a critical liaison between Sales and Product; sharing customer feedback with the Product Management, Operations and Engineering functions at Box. Do you want to tinker, whiteboard, brainstorm and figure out how things work? Our highest performers develop deep knowledge of the Box platform, and are capable of leading presentations related to the Box security story, technical architecture and product configuration.

This role is supporting clients in US Public Sector - to expand our footprint and break into new accounts. Are you curious, passionate about problem-solving and love working with leading-edge technology? Then we want to talk to you.

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of Enterprise Field Solutions Engineer experience or relevant technical, customer facing experience

Knowledge of government procurement cycles, RFP/RFI processes, and contract vehicles (e.g., GSA schedules)

Awareness of specific use cases such as citizen services modernization, secure document sharing across agencies, education collaboration needs etc.
Quickly grasp complex technical concepts related to Box’s solutions, especially our offerings, and clearly articulate their business value to drive informed decision-making.
Demonstrates creativity in designing tailored solutions that address unique challenges faced by public sector customers, leveraging Box’s capabilities to maximize impact.
You’re AI-curious and technically fluent — comfortable discussing LLMs, embeddings, automation, and context and prompt engineering concepts with both technical and business audiences
Strong presentation skills, with the ability to establish trust across a range of technical and non-technical audiences; passionate about showing, not just telling and designing demos and narratives that make the power of Box AI tangible

jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred

The Data Analyst (H/F) is responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that support strategic, operational, and business decisions. This role involves collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and performance metrics. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Data Analyst ensures that information is accurate, relevant, and delivered in a way that drives informed decision-making. This position is ideal for detail-oriented professionals with strong analytical and communication skills.

• Perform detailed analyses to identify trends, correlations, and insights that support business objectives.

Serves as the EMPC for their designated area and coordinates emergency plan review and inspection activity with the YC EMPC Liaison, the YC & PS Team Lead, and field inspectors. Reviews and endorses youth camp emergency plan submissions, inspections, and investigations, and prepares and presents cases for escalated enforcement. Serves as an Operations Branch representative with the Compliance Section for the Compliance Review Committee (CRC) meetings, informal conferences, and hearings. Reviews, documents, and responds to complaints regarding the youth camp emergency plans. Provides guidance and training to DSHS staff and regulated industry personnel and conducts joint inspections when required. Participates in emergency response training and performs emergency response activities. Assists in developing emergency plan policies and standard operating procedures (SOP). Assists with rule revision projects and in developing agency cost estimates and bill analysis during legislative sessions. Participates and coordinates with the Youth Camp Safety Multidisciplinary Team (YCSMT) and other emergency response agencies and organizations. Provides program support and performs other duties as assigned by the Manager to meet the needs of the Branch and Section. Works under limited supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

(35%) Receives and evaluates youth camp emergency plans, coordinates, assigns, and conducts inspections. Coordinates with the Youth Camp EMPC liaison, provides technical expertise, and maintains communication with Inspection Branches; Texas Department of Emergency Management (TDEM); Texas Fire Marshal’s Office; Texas Water Development Board (TWDB); Local Emergency Planning Committee’s (LEPCs); the State Medical Operations Center (SMOC); and other stakeholders. Participates on the Youth Camp Safety Multidisciplinary Team. Assures regulations are implemented effectively. Assists in developing policies and SOPs. Recommends updates to Program websites

(25%) Assists in developing and maintaining policies, SOPs, model youth camp emergency plans, education and outreach materials. Develops and delivers presentations. Reviews and endorses youth camp emergency plan inspection reports. Reports emergency plan review findings to the EMPC Liaison and Licensing Branch.

(15%) Receives, reviews, documents, and responds to complaints regarding youth camp emergency plans. Assigns complaints to Inspection staff for review and investigation. Reviews reports to ensure proper implementation of approved emergency plans. Prepares and presents cases for escalated enforcement. Serves as the Operations Branch representative at Compliance Review Committee (CRC) meetings and informal conferences. Participates in hearings as a department representative at the State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH).

(10%) Participates in emergency response training and performs emergency response activities. Attends and maintains training in emergency preparedness, management, and response. Evaluates and monitors state weather reports and recommendations.

(10%) Serves as a subject matter expert regarding youth camp emergency plans. Participates in rule revision projects; development of agency cost estimates and bill analyses; and. implementation of state legislation.

(5%) Performs other duties as assigned by the Manager to meet the needs of the Branch and Section. Duties also include actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role on occasion to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation.
